forwarder_said: "Please cancel the furniture booking, our client moved it to sea freight."
message_to_send: Dear Sara, thank you for letting us know. We have noted your request to cancel booking B-07 on SVZ 201 (6 pieces of furniture, 1,800 kg). The controller will confirm. Solvane Air Cargo capacity team.
why: The forwarder cancelled in writing, so release the whole booking: 1,800 kg and 14.0 m3, under the 2,000 kg limit (Space 3.1, 5.2). Fees are worked out by the app and confirmed by a person. Sources: booking B-07, forwarder F-04, message M-08, Space 3.1, 3.3, 5.2.
